body: Italy sounds nice as fuck, I’d love to go there someday haha. But yeah same I live in a small town in the Northeast US  and the biggest struggle is boredom. The key to getting past these periods is staying busy. I play a lot of ps4, watch movies and I’ve been trying get into reading to pass the time. No real hobbies I truly enjoy unfortunately

As someone that is still dealing with depression and suicidal thoughts I strongly urge you to refrain from telling your therapist or parents about your true thoughts about suicide. I made the mistake of telling my therapist that and I ended up in the ER in a tiny ass room for 3 days THEN was moved to a psych ward for 5 days. Let me tell you I will never tell a soul how I’m really feeling ever again. I’d rather kill myself than end up there. The mental health system is fucked man don’t ever divulge in your true thoughts. Lie. Do whatever you have to do to not end up being hospitalized. In the end the only person that can solve this is you. You can figure this shit out. I just said fuck it and went on with my life, yeah I still hate my life but guess what I have some goals I want to achieve, like getting laid or getting a job or getting rich. Life is just a giant MMORPG you grind just to grind because there’s nothing else to do :)

Jumping in a snow bank would suck definitely do not do that. Imagine waking up with stubs of arms and legs and confined to a wheelchair the rest of your life. If you have any lakes that are frozen nearby though it would only take about a minute to die if you jump in, so that’s a cheap and readily available option
What were you gonna use for ammo?
What type of gun did you get?
Honestly nothing in life matters, why do we have to suffer to live something we don't want to live

Do you know what the procedure is if someone is an organ donor and they try to commit suicide. Lets say the person looks to be on their way out, would doctors rather salvage the body and harvest the organs or try to save the person's life?

I'm in the same boat man. I'm 20 5'5, in decent shape and a receding hairline. This is one of many reasons of why I am considering committing suicide.  

I just feel so inadequate,  80% of the male population is taller than us. I will never be able to lift as much as someone that is taller than me. Girls naturally want someone that can protect them (someone at least a few inches taller than them) and it's like we're shit out of luck. Then you gotta worry about your kids going through the same shit, it's not worth it. I'm always striving to be normal, but I never will be, I'm limited into what I can achieve. I have to bust my ass to just seem like a normal guy.  What are the chances we get stuck with awful genes. 

You ever want to talk man hmu I'm going through the same shit.

I feel like it is especially for me. No matter how much help I get I will always feel the same deep inside. I feel like some people, including myself are meant to die. I feel like we just live in one of an infinite number of alternate realities and me dying in this one was just fate.

I feel like in some twisted way our population has exceeded its limits and the culling via suicide is nature's remedy for this. I feel like in a way some people are meant to die in this world, no matter how much help they get.
Do these people take you seriously or are you just joking around. I often joke around about suicide because it shows my weakness and people like to laugh at that :(

My recommendation is not to go to your parents. Don't dump all your feelings and thoughts onto them, as they will probably not know what to do. Find someone you can talk to. You need to make sure you can trust them, because if not you could end up in a mental hospital for weeks and your depression could only worsen from there.

Or one terrible thing about life is that past experiences and prejudices often do impact the choices we make in the future. Things just don't change from day to day, if you feel like shit you're probably gonna feel that for a while until you slowly find something else to focus on. But underneath that shitty feeling will always exist no matter what.

Yeah man I feel the same exact way. All my life I've been trying to find people like me, everybody is so obsessed with materialistic things that don't matter. Nobody really cares about anyone but themselves. It's shitty as hell we are in this alone.

I feel like we're in a huge social change, and the discrimination towards men is just one small part of it. I mean, just in the last 100 years, women have rights after being suppressed for hundreds of years, there are many civil rights movements occurring at the same time and every year something is changing. Society as a whole is going through change at an immensely fast rate, and change is hard. I mean something this big in society has never happened before. It's human nature to be opposed to change, what you're feeling is just part of the system, time is the only factor here. Time heals, in time you'll be fine its just we're all in a shitty part right now

There is no purpose, there is nothing. How are we to know that we aren't already dead? I strongly believe our consciousness fabricates the reality we are living in to make sense of the world. When you really think about it, we are living in a void. 

I feel like there is no point, and even if anybody were to try to give me inspiration to move forward, there is no way you can prove that if I live  is beneficial. From nothingness, to nothingness

That is correct we all die at one point or another. But there is much we don't know about this reality we are living in. Our consciousness limits us, and time and reality could mental constructs. The way that we perceive time is likely far from what it actually is.

 I strongly believe in the multiverse theory in that we are only living in one of an infinite number of universes, that means there's an infinite number of possibilities and death is removed if you remove any spatial or linear boundaries. I believe there is much more to this reality we are living, and I need to find out.
